test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive form.

He will visit the orphanage tomorrow.

options.text: The orphanage must be visited by him tomorrow.
The orphanage is visited by him tomorrow.
The orphanage will be visited by him tomorrow.
The orphanage should be visited by him tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "He will visit the orphanage tomorrow."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the orphanage" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will visit" to "will be visited" (future simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "him."
 
• Ensure the time phrase "tomorrow" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The orphanage will be visited by him tomorrow."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The orphanage must be visited by him tomorrow." – Incorrect modal verb (must instead of will).
 
• **Option 2: **"The orphanage is visited by him tomorrow." – Incorrect tense (present simple passive instead of future simple passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The orphanage should be visited by him tomorrow." – Incorrect modal verb (should instead of will).
